name: USAGov directory of local governments (limited-coverage fallback)
handles: Official federal directory that links to contact information for local governments by state; Civic Compass has no verified city-department records for this location.
complaint_process: Use the directory to find your city or county government, then look for its code-enforcement, health, or public-works contact.
evidence: Find contact information for local governments by state.

name: USAGov directory of state governments and agencies (limited-coverage fallback)
handles: Official federal directory that links to state governments, governors, and state agencies such as consumer protection, social services, and health; Civic Compass has no verified state-agency records outside Connecticut.
complaint_process: Choose your state in the directory, then the agency that matches your issue.
evidence: contact information for state governments, governors, elected officials

name: Plural (Open States) Find Your Legislator tool (limited-coverage fallback)
handles: Free tool that finds a resident's state legislators by location; used because Civic Compass verifies state legislators only for Connecticut.
